response.sql: WITH per_tx AS (SELECT t.transreg AS transreg, t.ordertypedist AS ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_short, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_opt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg GROUP BY t.transreg, t.ordertypedist), with_base AS (SELECT transreg, ordertypedist, avg_short, avg_opt, AVG(avg_short) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS baseline FROM per_tx) SELECT transreg AS transaction_reference, ordertypedist AS order_type_mix, avg_short AS avg_short_interest, avg_opt AS avg_option_volume_ratio, CASE WHEN baseline IS NULL OR baseline = 0 THEN NULL ELSE avg_short / baseline END AS short_interest_ratio FROM with_base ORDER BY short_interest_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
